note: 23 Nov, the owner: "cut away" (80% kept), "Bobert NBob Flash Next" (N = billions of parameters left), final name "Bobert 101Bob A6B Flash-Next REAP80" (A6B = about 6B active per word, unchanged by the cut), "we should offer other quants, and have them on huggingface right away". The pod downloads Unsloth's Q8_0 Flash-Next (188 GB, 6 parts), cuts 102 of 512 experts out of every layer by the REAP 80% keep list (all-keep-80.json from reap-flashnext-q4-jobs, read from the normal Nov 21 runs, never held-out), runs llama-imatrix on the cut brain with training chats only (calib-prep imatrix/all.txt), then makes IQ2_XXS, IQ2_M, Q3_K_M, IQ4_XS and Q4_K_M and puts each on Hugging Face (MouseWurX/Bobert-{N}Bob-A6B-Flash-Next-REAP80-GGUF, PUBLIC) as soon as it is made, with the base model's LICENSE unchanged, the keep list, the imatrix and a card saying "unproven in our lab, as we have yet to test". Then it serves the IQ2_XXS (the size for a 16 GB card with 32 GB of RAM) and Bob's HELD-OUT jobs (inbox, office, repo, web) are scored, to compare with the Q4 rows of reap-flashnext-q4-jobs (all experts, and the 80% mask). Nothing is healed. 23 Nov second run: the first rental (about $4.30) made the cut and the imatrix but no quant; fixed: quants are written as .part and count only once listed, a cut brain that fails to load holds the pod 45 min for a fix, the IQ2 gap overrides (q8_0 small tensors, q2_k experts and the n-gram embedding), and the imatrix is reused from the repo.

benchmark.note: one H200: the pod cuts Flash-Next (Q8_0 to REAP 80%), quantizes, uploads each quant, then serves the IQ2_XXS for the held-out jobs.

cut.expect_note: 24 Nov: predicted from the first IQ2_XXS (65.8 GB, down experts fell to iq4_nl). Flash-Next's down experts are 640 wide and the n-gram embedding 160 wide; at IQ2 the down experts are forced to q2_0 (2.25 bits, 64-wide groups, which 640 fits); the embedding can only take a 32-wide type (q4_0, ~29 GB, read from the drive). A file outside +-10% of its prediction is not uploaded. Unsloth's own full-size UD-Q2_0 is 70.5 GB, so ~63 GB at 80% kept.
